rules.logic: ABIOC(Dormancy-Break Traffic Burst on a Strategically Aged Domain) AND ABIOC(Never-Before-Seen DGA Subdomain Fan-Out Under a Newly-Activated Apex) — fuses the same-day dormancy-break traffic burst and the never-before-seen DGA subdomain fan-out on the SAME apex_domain within the activation window into a single strategically-aged-sleeper-domain-activation incident, anchored to the aged apex the newly-registered-domain block never flagged.
rules.name: Strategically Aged Sleeper-Domain Activation — Burst + DGA Fan-Out Stitch
